custom.path_syntax_guide_desc:
Use wildcards to match file names that vary, and placeholders to keep a path valid after importing and exporting across devices

Using {{p|game}}: This placeholder requires you to enable the 'Add Game Install Folder Name' option and provide the exact folder name of the game. Make sure the game folder can be found under one of the paths under 'Options → Settings → Game Install Locations'
custom.wildcard_star: Any number of characters, including none, within a single file or folder name
custom.wildcard_globstar: Any number of folder levels, including none

cloud.test_failed: Connection testing found a failure. Review the failed check below.
cloud.error_REDIRECT_REFUSED: The service returned an unsafe, excessive or unsupported redirect. Check its endpoint URL.
cloud.restore_missing_target: This target was absent; rollback removes it after creating a protection backup.
cloud.multipart_cleanup_pending: Upload cancelled. Remote multipart data still needs cleanup; retry after resolving the connection or permission error.
cloud.title: Cloud backup
cloud.intro: Copy local backups to your storage, then choose a specific version to download or restore.
cloud.settings_intro: Save multiple connections. Automatic upload is off by default and uses one destination at a time.
cloud.remove_connection_hint: Remove the configuration for “{{name}}”. Remote data is kept. Cancel any unfinished jobs first.
cloud.configure_first: Add a connection and choose a repository in storage settings first.
cloud.wizard_steps: Protocol → Connection → Test → Repository → Automatic upload scope
cloud.name: Connection name
cloud.http_warning: HTTP exposes credentials and saves in transit. Use it only on a trusted network. HTTPS certificates are always verified.
cloud.read_only: Read-only connection (browse and restore; skip write tests)
cloud.session_only: Keep credentials for this session only
cloud.credentials_configured: Credentials configured. Leave fields blank to keep them. Entered credentials are cleared after saving.
cloud.credentials_hint: Passwords use system-protected storage. Choose session-only if it is unavailable. Remote backups are not end-to-end encrypted.
cloud.test_complete: Connection test completed. Review each permission result.
cloud.select_repository_hint: Choose an existing repository to access backups from another device.
cloud.no_repositories: No repositories found. Create one or check the address and read permissions.
cloud.new_repository_hint: A new repository is separate from existing backups. Discover and select the original repository when connecting another device.
cloud.repository_ready: Repository ready. You can choose an automatic upload scope below.
cloud.automatic_hint: Only new local versions are uploaded. Preview historical backups before uploading them manually. Changing destinations affects new jobs only.
cloud.local_upload_hint: Queue this local version. Its cloud name and permanent status are copied at upload time.
cloud.queued: Job queued. Check the cloud task status.
cloud.history_confirmation: Upload {{count}} versions, approximately {{size}}. Packaging and upload begin after confirmation.
cloud.no_local_versions: No local versions available. Create a local backup first.
cloud.cache_hint: The directory may be cached. Remote versions are verified again when downloaded.
cloud.no_cloud_versions: No matching cloud versions. Refresh the directory or change your filters.
cloud.restore_confirmation: Download and verify this version, check restore paths, then protect current saves before restoring. Verification, path-check or protection failures stop restoration.
cloud.delete_confirmation: Delete only this cloud version. Local backups are kept. This cannot be undone. S3 server-side historical versions may still occupy space.
cloud.delete_permanent_confirmation: This version is marked permanent. Confirm that you still want to delete this cloud version permanently.
cloud.local_cloud_separate: Local backup results and cloud task status are separate. Network failures do not change completed local backups.
cloud.verification_traffic: Verifying by reading back data; this may use download bandwidth.
cloud.operation_failed: Cloud operation failed. Check task details.
cloud.error_PATH_MAPPING_REQUIRED: Downloaded locally. This version requires account or path mapping. Review its local restore targets before restoring.
cloud.error_SECURE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: System-protected storage is unavailable. Choose session-only credentials and try again.
cloud.select_games_required: Select at least one game or explicitly choose all games.
cloud.cleanup_residual: Test object cleanup failed. Remaining object: {{key}}
cloud.restore_mapping_hint: Choose a destination on this computer for each required mapping. Current saves are protected before the selected version is restored.
cloud.confirm_registry: I confirm replacing the registry keys listed for this version
cloud.not_queued: {{game}}: Local backup succeeded; cloud backup was not queued.
cloud.error_INVALID_CONFIG: Invalid cloud configuration. Check the address and repository settings.
cloud.error_NOT_FOUND: The cloud backup or local version was not found.
cloud.error_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Storage authentication failed. Check your credentials.
cloud.error_ACCESS_DENIED: Insufficient storage permissions. Check account access.
cloud.error_CREDENTIALS_UNAVAILABLE: Protected credentials are unavailable. Enter them again.
cloud.error_INTEGRITY_ERROR: Backup integrity verification failed. The operation was stopped.
cloud.error_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: This repository uses a newer format. Update the application.
cloud.error_SPACE_LIMIT: Cloud cache budget exceeded. Increase the budget or handle existing jobs.
cloud.error_RESTORE_FAILED: Restore did not fully complete. Check its results and the protection backup.
cloud.error_REGISTRY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: This version includes registry entries. Explicit confirmation is required to restore them.
cloud.error_SNAPSHOT_DELETED: This cloud version was deleted and cannot be uploaded again with its original identity.
cloud.error_CONFLICT: Conflicting version identity. Existing content has been kept.
cloud.error_ACTIVE_JOBS: Cancel or complete this connection’s jobs first.
cloud.error_UNTRUSTED_SENDER: A request from an untrusted window was rejected.
cloud.error_NETWORK_ERROR: Storage is temporarily unreachable. Try again later.
cloud.error_CERTIFICATE_ERROR: The server certificate could not be verified. Check the trusted CA and service address.
cloud.error_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Cloud storage capacity or quota exceeded.
cloud.error_CLOUD_ERROR: Cloud backup failed. Check the connection settings and storage permissions.
cloud.batch_upload_result: Queued {{accepted}} uploads; {{rejected}} versions could not be queued.
cloud.refresh_invalid: Directory refreshed; {{count}} invalid or incompatible manifests were skipped.
cloud.cached_unconfirmed: Cached record: remote presence was not confirmed on this refresh
cloud.duplicate_content: Identical content already has a verified cloud backup
cloud.custom_game_registered: This custom game was added locally using the confirmed save paths.
cloud.custom_game_existing: This custom game already exists locally; its settings were kept.
cloud.custom_game_failed: Saves were restored, but this custom game could not be added locally. Add it using the confirmed paths to make future backups.
cloud.error_LISTING_LIMIT: The storage listing reached the service limit and may be incomplete. Narrow the directory scope and try again.
cloud.attention_count: {{count}} cloud tasks or notices to review
cloud.cancel_upload_before_delete: Cloud tasks still need this local version. Keep it until packaging finishes, or cancel its cloud tasks before deleting it.
cloud.migration_busy: Complete or cancel cloud tasks and active local operations before migrating the backup library.
